alex: FYI CI on my PR 7010 failing after I rebased onto main, snapshots + one unit test. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7010 ci-bot: build #7010 — failed — tests: snapshot_test.py::test_component_render (snapshot mismatch) priya: @alex can you share the diff for the snapshot? :eyes: alex: here's the snapshot diff (huge), not sure why these changed — I only touched batching logic. sam: seems like regression from runtime change? I saw similar in staging yesterday. Which test name is failing exactly? alex: snapshot_test.py::test_component_render and unit_test.py::test_kv_cache_reload failing with NPE in CacheManager marco: NPE sounds real. Did the rebase bring in the cache init change from #6998? That patch changed init ordering. priya: if the snapshots legitimately changed we can update them, but let's not blindly update if it's a behavior change. @sam can you run the failing job locally and check stack? sam: running locally now: `yarn test snapshot_test -t test_component_render` — will post logs. ci-bot: Re-run requested by sam — job queued (circleci/ci: pr-7010) alex: log snippet: ``` AssertionError: Snapshot mismatch - expected "
old
" + received "
new-prefix-old
" ``` Also stack: `CacheManager.reload() -> null pointer at line 42` jen: @priya @alex quick check — I think "new-prefix" comes from a change in template rendering order. If that's intended, we should update snapshots; otherwise revert that change. priya: ok can someone bisect? If it's from #6998 I'll revert the ordering tweak and request a patch. Sam do you have a quick revert we can test? sam: I made a temp branch that reverts the init ordering — running tests now. ci-bot: Job #7010.2 — passed all tests (snapshot_test and unit_test) on sam/revert-cache-init priya: OK that pins it to the init ordering. @alex please revert your rebase or I'll open a follow-up to adjust init ordering properly. Also need one more approval for the revert PR. alex: I'll open PR to revert the problematic change and mark for urgent review. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7012 marco: I'll review asap. If CI is green we'll merge and then re-open a follow-up to land the proper fix. priya: sounds good — @alex ping me when PR green. :thumbsup: alex: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. :rocket:
